g.text: Synthetic 3 km terrain (fractal relief, 1 200 craters, albedo noise) rendered at 25° sun elevation; 32 × 32-pixel descent templates matched by
normalised cross-correlation in a ±20-pixel window, 40 trials per point. (c) Root-sum-square of landmark error/√N (6 m map, 20° sun change), map
registration and attitude-knowledge error projected over the altitude.
